bestiary.w: Battle Tower roof, Ring 0: Home (every tower has one)
bestiary.g: iron gear and a bow
bestiary.u: Opens Age 3 (Iron & Tinkering) for everyone. Tower chests full of Age 2 loot, and diamonds from the Golem itself.

bestiary.g: a Tinkers or iron weapon, milk for mining fatigue
bestiary.u: Opens Age 4 (Nether & Power) for everyone. Wet sponges.

bestiary.g: strong ranged damage and full armor
bestiary.u: Nether Star: beacons, the Dragon Egg Mill and Draconic fusion.

bestiary.g: diamond-tier weapons, bow, water bucket
bestiary.u: Opens Age 6 (Mastery) for everyone. Dragon's breath, End cities (elytra in their ships), and the egg: hatch it (Dragon Mounts) or keep it for the Dragon Egg Mill; a new egg is crafted from a Dragon Heart, a Nether Star, 2 End Crystals, 2 Shulker Shells, 2 Dragon's Breath and a Wither Rose.

bestiary.g: best armor you have; sneak, do not fight blind
bestiary.u: A sculk catalyst. The ancient city loot (echo shards, Swift Sneak books) doesn't need the kill: sneaking past is safer.

bestiary.g: Age-5 weapon, shield
bestiary.u: Naga scales (armor) and the way on to the Lich Tower.

bestiary.g: Age-5 weapon, ranged damage for the clones
bestiary.u: Opens Age 6 (Mastery) for everyone. Its trophy and a scepter.

bestiary.g: Age-5 weapon
bestiary.u: Meef Stroganoff (eat it before the Fire Swamp and the Hydra), a Diamond Minotaur Axe and the trophy.

bestiary.g: Age-6 armor, fire resistance
bestiary.u: Hydra chop; the trophy feeds Industrial Foregoing supreme frames.

bestiary.g: Age-6 weapon
bestiary.u: Phantom armor and the trophy.

bestiary.w: Dark Tower, Dark Forest (after the Knight Phantoms)
bestiary.g: Age-6 weapon, ranged damage
bestiary.u: Fiery tools and the trophy.

bestiary.g: Age-6 armor; beat the Lich first (the Snowy Forest freezes you until then)
bestiary.u: Yeti armor (from its fur), ice bombs, and the way into the Glacier.

bestiary.g: Age-6 weapon and armor
bestiary.u: A triple bow or seeker bow, and the trophy.

bestiary.g: a pickaxe, zanite or better: swords do no damage
bestiary.u: Opens the bronze dungeon loot.

bestiary.g: 10 victory medals (one per Valkyrie in the dungeon), Age-5 weapon and armor
bestiary.u: Silver loot (Valkyrie lance and armor). She takes all 10 medals from her Valkyries.

bestiary.g: Age-5 armor, fire protection
bestiary.u: Gold dungeon loot.

bestiary.g: Age-6 weapons and armor, plus an Elementium Axe for the killing blow
bestiary.u: Gaia Spirits every time (one goes into the Mastery Crown). An Elementium Axe kill may also drop its head, a trophy only.

bestiary.g: Age-6 Draconic gear
bestiary.u: Chaos shards: one goes into the Mastery Crown, the guide's final trophy.

bestiary.g: hit its back after it swings; shield helps
bestiary.u: Opens Age 4 (Nether & Power) for everyone. The Wrought Axe, a heavy sweeping axe.

bestiary.g: wait for its snap, hit while it pulls back
bestiary.u: Foliaath seeds: plant your own guard plant.

bestiary.g: ranged damage; break through the masked guards
bestiary.u: Opens Age 5 (New Worlds) for everyone. The Sun Chief's mask.

bestiary.g: fire resistance does not help: dodge the freezing breath
bestiary.u: Opens Age 5 (New Worlds) for everyone. The Ice Crystal: a frost-breath weapon.

bestiary.w: CQR pirate ships on the coast, ring 1 (1,500-4,000 blocks)
bestiary.g: iron armor, a shield for the musket fire, a bow or good sword; bring a boat
bestiary.u: The Captain Revolver, an early gun; TaCZ guns open up in Age 4.

bestiary.g: iron or diamond armor and a ranged weapon; he summons undead, so fight in the doorway
bestiary.u: Enchanted books and emeralds; Cursed Bone is a collectible.

bestiary.w: Fish's Undead Rising crypts and desert tombs, Ring 1: Frontier
bestiary.g: iron armor and a stack of food; he calls skeleton guards, so a bow or a shield helps
bestiary.u: Opens Age 4 (Nether & Power) for everyone. The Crown of Rule: a helmet that turns nearby skeletons into your servants while you wear it. No recipe uses it.

bestiary.w: plains and ruins, Ring 1: Frontier (294 HP)
bestiary.g: diamond armor and a diamond sword; kite it, its swings are slow but heavy
bestiary.u: The Tough Glove, a utility artifact. A tough early miniboss, not a gate.

bestiary.g: full diamond or Tinkers cobalt tier, a shield and a strong melee weapon; expect illusions and tornadoes
bestiary.u: Opens Age 5 (New Worlds) for everyone. The Walker sword and King's shield: the first Hexxit II boss gear.

bestiary.g: armor with poison resistance or milk on hand, torches, a sword that hits fast
bestiary.u: Spider Leather and Giant Spider Venom have no crafting recipe in this pack: they are trophies. The spider shield can turn up in Hexxit tower loot.

bestiary.g: diamond tier and a bow; its shell blocks frontal hits
bestiary.u: Giant Tortoise Scales have no crafting recipe in this pack; the turtle shield can turn up in Hexxit tower loot.

bestiary.w: CQR towers, Ring 1: Frontier; not the Twilight Lich
bestiary.g: cobalt-tier gear or better, ranged options and a way to heal; it summons skeletons
bestiary.u: Mostly books and bones; the real prize is the tower chests above it.

bestiary.w: ruined temples, Ring 1: Frontier (84 HP, summons duplicates)
bestiary.g: strong AoE or a fast weapon; kill the copies first or ignore them and burst the real one
bestiary.u: Ectoplasm and the Vessel item (collectibles).

bestiary.w: overworld at night, Ring 1 and further out
bestiary.g: Tinkers cobalt or Hexxit set bonuses and a way to see in the dark; fight it on open ground
bestiary.u: The Reaper Scythe and Necronomicon pages for the Harken Scythe line and its soul crafting.

bestiary.g: water breathing and a fast weapon; it hides in a ruin chest and bites when you open it
bestiary.u: Esca (sometimes): eat it for a minute of Greedy Eye, which outlines nearby chests. Also Lunkertooth eggs.

bestiary.g: fire resistance, a bow and enchanted diamond gear
bestiary.u: Ghast tears brew regeneration potions; blaze powder fuels brewing and makes Eyes of Ender.

bestiary.w: the End, a CQR arena, after the Dragon
bestiary.g: Draconic wyvern armor or better, ranged and melee, lots of healing; it throws blocks and lightning
bestiary.u: Throws its loot out one item at a time from a treasure pool: mixed End-tier supplies.

bestiary.w: your Gaia arena: right-click the beacon with a Gaia Spirit Ingot instead of Terrasteel
bestiary.g: Age-6 weapons (Draconic sword, or a Supremium Sword without the AOE charm), a full Draconic set or a 24-point Nyx set, healing and a lot of room
bestiary.u: More Gaia Spirits and rare Botania relics; harder than the first fight.

bestiary.w: four different Chaos Islands far out in the End
bestiary.g: charged Draconic armor and a Draconic sword, plenty of healing, a way home (the island breaks up)
bestiary.u: Spare chaos shards for chaotic cores; not needed for the Mastery Crown, which uses one shard.
